validator_share_ppt: modified Param validator_unbonding_blocks: modified Param validators_to_eject: modified Param validators_to_promote: modified Changelog: Ratify slot/tranche position rent (D-0524, R5.4e/f, E.54, F.7, G.4): replacements retain historical earned rent, failed or forfeited deltas refund the payer, and new tariffs use separate funded tranches. Supersede independent provider ceilings; add seven executable balance vectors. Changelog: Dispose implemented HTLC pair directions as target-only for initial publication (E.48, #1498). Preserve cross-leg late-claim, finality-stall and failed-payout counterexamples, qualify the local formal models, and add focused pallet/contract expiry-ordering tests and a reproducible pair gate. Changelog: Specify the Agent airdrop unlock as spend-to-unlock (R8.7, R8.8; D-0522). An Agent grant unlocks nothing at its start and has no end block; it unlocks one FLOP per three FLOP of its locked principal in the gross `payable` of settled sessions, once every fraud dispute raised in the window has resolved, and its locked compute spend is capped at three quarters of principal. Channel escrow drawn from locked principal goes to the `payable` first and is refunded first, back to the grant as frozen principal. E.38 no longer holds the Agent horizon. Changelog: Make current-profile channel settlements payment-only (R11.2b, task 1494). Receipt claims no longer feed public work rewards or performance vesting, including unilateral/DA-void payout. Historical recovery and future audited credit remain open; the distinct decision ID awaits approval. Changelog: Tighten the Appendix F vector schema to require canonical fields, byte widths, integer ranges, case identities, and coverage. Wide integers use decimal strings so JSON consumers preserve their exact values; the public generator also checks duplicate identities. Changelog: Replace §8.2's Miner and Validator airdrop unlock (R8.7, R8.8; D-0517). A Miner grant is a quarter liquid at its start and unlocks the rest one FLOP per FLOP it receives as miner from settled sessions once their dispute window passes, with no end block; block rewards earn no credit, and the performance adjustment is retired. A Validator grant stays frozen until the first halving, then grants release one per day without unbonding; none releases until E.38 fixes the order. Only Agent grants may still spend locked principal on compute; a miner may bond its locked principal as its own self-stake. Changelog: Make block rewards and the subsidy liquid on issue (R9.13; D-0518). The miner and validator legs and the Labs/Foundation subsidy are never auto-compounded, force-staked or vested, and agent-leg payouts are liquid once E.40 ratifies; validator earnings no longer auto-compound into locked stake, and E.39 is closed. Changelog: Ratify §8.2's grant-landing (R8.6) and claim and locked-spend (R8.8) rules as D-0515. D-0514 had covered only R8.3–R8.5 and R8.7; the requirement text is unchanged. Changelog: Repoint Appendix E blockers to live trackers and refresh Appendix H implementation grades for fee distribution, metering overflow, session-key invariants, and collusion monitoring. Changelog: Ratified D-0519 (owner, 2026-10-04): paid-storage service lanes close at a fixed boundary with a funding-pinned claim deadline on the finalized prefix. Only the lane's provider redeems, with strict sequence, counter and amount checks, including after reassignment. Otherwise-valid post-close signatures remain payable within the unspent budget until the deadline; finalization refunds only the remainder above it. Unknown finality rejects both operations. R5.4g, R5.4j, E.54, F.7 and G.4 carry the rule. E.54 constrains sequential entitlement-maturity and funded-request timing to fit that fixed dead Changelog: Era-T conversion and airdrop vesting (§8.2, R8.3–R8.8; D-0514). Conversion draws only on the fixed genesis cohort pools. Agents are scored on settled compute-channel spend and miners on verified effective-FLOP; balance, stake, job count and active days carry no weight. Snapshot and evidence of record are fixed before genesis lock. Grants land as frozen genesis balances with linear vesting and finalized-head claims. The miner performance adjustment fails closed: without both performance inputs a Miner grant unlocks nothing before its end block. E.38 keeps score caps, the validator activity basi Changelog: Development-network exception to the paid-storage activation gate (D-0512, R5.4q): a valueless devnet may run the §5.4 extension ahead of E.54 only from a runtime built with a non-default, development-only flag, under an explicitly unratified profile with placeholder values kept out of the canonical parameters, with unaudited rent releases marked as such, and with no result citable as E.54/E.47 evidence. R5.4k now names R5.4q as its only exception; every other network is unchanged.
